# Aethelios concierge core 0.1.0

Pure shared identity, branch capability contract, context projection and general routine templates for Legacy Reserve. No founder runtime imports or shared private memory. Runtime tools, authentication and budgets belong to the consumer server. Shared source does not imply cross-platform account/context linking.

The initial consumer vendors the exact files at a pinned Git commit with SHA-256 integrity checks. This avoids exposing private repository credentials or introducing a package registry. Update through a reviewed upstream revision, never through an independent local personality fork.

Run `npm test` inside this directory. The package has no runtime dependencies. Clinical pathways are educational only and no partnership is asserted.
